fields.name: collection
fields.note: Polymorphic discriminator of the related collection (products or categories). Alias — matches the live schema created by the R7 migration.

fields.name: item
fields.note: Polymorphic key of the related item. Column (the R7 migration created it with a real column; only the discriminator is an alias).

fields.name: media_sources

fields.name: brand_key
fields.note: Server-owned normalized brand label; original brand remains unchanged.

fields.name: identity_key
fields.note: SHA256 of normalized brand and article. Backfill and constraint cutover require migrate-product-identity.mjs; no automatic brand aliasing.

fields.name: sku_normalized
fields.note: Derived uppercase alphanumeric copy of sku, filled only by migrations/backfill-product-search.mjs. Indexed search key, never edited by hand.

fields.name: mpn_normalized
fields.note: Derived uppercase alphanumeric copy of mpn, filled only by migrations/backfill-product-search.mjs. Indexed search key, never edited by hand.

fields.name: image_items

fields.name: specification_items

fields.name: document_items

fields.name: analogs_from

fields.name: analogs_to

collections.name: product_codes
collections.note: Additional OEM/MPN/supplier/previous/superseded/external/barcode codes of a product (ADR-003); products.sku and products.mpn stay the canonical article fields. The composite UNIQUE (product, code_type, normalized_code, source_name) is created by migrations/sql/product-search-indexes-up.sql — the Directus REST API cannot express composite constraints.

fields.name: normalized_code
fields.note: Uppercase alphanumeric copy of code: the indexed OEM search key.

fields.name: source_name
fields.note: Provenance of the code (feed or catalog name, 'manual' for editors).

collections.name: products_analogs
collections.note: Typed one-edge relations between products (R8, ADR-003): analog/oem_cross/compatible are symmetric — canonical_key derives from the SORTED id pair so a mirror duplicate is physically impossible under the unique key; superseded_by is directed and keeps the from/to order. No self-edges (CHECK) and UNIQUE canonical_key are enforced by migrations/sql/product-analogs-constraints-up.sql — the Directus REST API cannot express table CHECKs.

fields.name: canonical_key
fields.note: Deterministic edge key '<type>:<from>:<to>': the pair is SORTED for the symmetric types and the direction preserved for superseded_by. Physically UNIQUE via migrations/sql/product-analogs-constraints-up.sql; recomputed and verified by migrations/reconcile-product-analogs.mjs.

fields.name: source_name
fields.note: Provenance of the relation (feed or catalog name, 'manual' for editors).

collections.name: seo_work_items
collections.note: Control-plane queue of the SEO content factory (R10A, Task 14): one row per worker recommendation with evidence, sources and a draft-only patch. The W1 worker only ever writes status=draft; ready/review/applied/rolled_back/rejected are human lifecycle transitions. status is Directus choices, NOT a SQL enum. dedupe_key (sha256 of entity+type+subtype+patch) is physically UNIQUE via migrations/sql/seo-work-items-constraints-up.sql — the Directus REST API cannot express the constraint without creating a duplicate of its own. High-volume crawl telemetry is never written here.

fields.name: type
fields.note: Recommendation type, for example missing_meta or title_rewrite.

fields.name: subtype
fields.note: Optional refinement of type.

fields.name: severity
fields.note: Impact label of the recommendation (minor/major/...).

fields.name: confidence
fields.note: Model/analysis confidence 0..1.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.note: Target collection of the recommendation: articles, categories, products, pages or home_page.

fields.name: entity_key
fields.note: Stable human key of the target (slug/sku) — survives re-imports that change entity_id.

fields.name: current_value_json
fields.note: Snapshot of the target field values at analysis time.

fields.name: patch_json
fields.note: Allowlisted field patch the worker proposes; applied only after human approval.

fields.name: evidence_json
fields.note: Claim-to-source evidence tiers backing the recommendation.

fields.name: metrics_json
fields.note: Compact decision metrics only — crawl telemetry lives outside this collection.

fields.name: dedupe_key
fields.note: Deterministic sha256 of entity_type+entity_key+type+subtype+patch (seo-worker computeDedupeKey). Physically UNIQUE via migrations/sql/seo-work-items-constraints-up.sql, the product_codes/analogs precedent.

fields.name: before_hash
fields.note: sha256 of the target field values at analysis time; a mismatch means the entity changed and the proposal is stale.

fields.name: article
fields.note: Nullable M2O to the draft article created from an approved work item. Junction side only — articles carries no O2M alias (production R7 lesson).

fields.name: worker_run_id
fields.note: Run identifier of the W1 worker that produced or claimed the item.

fields.name: claimed_at
fields.note: When a worker run claimed the item for execution.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.note: Claim expiry; an expired claim may be taken over by another run.

fields.name: request_key
fields.note: Durable first-party request identity. Nullable only for legacy orders.

collections.name: order_items
collections.note: Snapshot line items for an order. order→products is SET NULL on product deletion to preserve history.
